researchDraft.querySummary: On 2026-08-10, the clearest signal in the research window is Beijing's Aug 7 property easing notice (effective Aug 8), which cut the non-Beijing household purchase requirement inside the 5th Ring Road from 2 years to 1 year, liberalised gift transfers, and doubled provident-fund loan caps. This directly operationalises the July 30 Politburo 'security barrier' language and signals that first-tier curbs are now being dismantled as a demand-stabilisation tool amid weak physical-market data and divergent analyst reads.

en.title: Beijing dismantles last purchase-restriction barrier: first-tier easing under 'security barrier' framing
en.coreFact: On Aug 7, Beijing issued a 7-measure notice effective Aug 8: the social-security/income-tax requirement for non-Beijing households buying inside the 5th Ring Road was cut from 2 years to 1 year, unifying the citywide requirement; parents transferring homes to adult children no longer need purchaser-qualification checks; provident-fund loan caps were doubled (couples up to 2.4M yuan for first homes, rising to 3.4M with add-ons) with a second loan allowed after prior loans are cleared; and renovation withdrawals up to 250K yuan were introduced.
en.whyItMatters: This is the most concrete execution yet of the July 30 Politburo line that moved property from risk prevention into the 'security barrier' framing with promises of pragmatic incremental policy. It changes the process read because Beijing — the last first-tier purchase-restriction citadel — is now actively using demand-side easing, not just containment, to stabilise the housing system. The next test is whether easing can slow tier-one secondary-price declines (Morgan Stanley cut 2026 forecasts on the same day) or merely fuels land-king anomalies without volume recovery (CLSA argues bottoming accelerates).
en.processMatchReason: Directly maps to process-china-property-local-finance: the measure alters the property-credit channel (provident funds), local demand conditions and the fiscal-land nexus at the highest-tier market, shifting the process from pure balance-sheet repair toward active demand stabilisation.

zh.title: 北京拆除限购最后壁垒：一线松绑纳入‘安全屏障’框架
zh.coreFact: 8月7日，北京发布3方面7项措施、8月8日起执行：非京籍家庭购买五环内住房的社保/个税年限由2年降至1年，全市统一为1年；父母将住房赠与成年子女不再核查购房资格；公积金贷款上限翻倍（首套家庭最高240万元，叠加多子女、绿色建筑等最高340万元），还清贷款后可再次申请公积金贷款；新增装修提取最高25万元。
zh.whyItMatters: 这是对7月30日政治局会议将房地产从‘防风险’升格为‘切实筑牢安全屏障’、并承诺‘谋划出台务实管用的增量政策’的最直接落地。它改变了对中国房地产与地方财政转型进程的判断：最后一个一线限购堡垒开始主动用需求端工具托底，而不仅仅是风险管控。接下来要看一线二手房价格跌幅能否被政策对冲——同日摩根士丹利下调2026年房地产预测，而里昂证券认为北京放松将加速市场筑底。
zh.processMatchReason: 该事件直接对应process-china-property-local-finance：改变公积金信贷渠道、本地购房需求与土地-财政联动，标志着进程从纯资产负债表修复转向主动稳需求阶段。

ja.title: 北京が最後の購入制限を撤廃へ——第1線都市の緩和は『安全の盾』枠組みで
ja.coreFact: 2026年8月7日、北京は3分野7項目の通知を発表し8月8日から施行。非北京籍世帯が5環路内で住宅を購入する際の社会保険・個人所得税納付期間を2年から1年に短縮し全市で1年に統一。親から成年子への住宅贈与では購入資格審査を不要に。積立金ローンの上限を倍増し（夫婦で初回240万元、加算条件で最大340万元）、完済後の2回目ローンも可能に。リフォーム引き出し上限25万元も新設。
ja.whyItMatters: 7月30日の政治局会議が不動産を『リスク防止』から『安全の盾を築く』枠組みへ引き上げ、『実務的な追加政策』を約束したことを最も具体的に実行するもの。最後まで残った第1線都市の購入制限が、封じ込めではなく需要安定化の手段として動き出した点で、プロセス認識を変える。同日にモルガン・スタンレーが2026年予測を下方修正する一方、CLSAは市場底入れ加速を見込むという解釈の分かれが次の焦点。
ja.processMatchReason: process-china-property-local-financeに直接的に対応。積立金信用チャネル、住宅需要、土地・財政の連関を最高位市場で変更し、バランスシート修復から積極的な需要安定化へ段階を移す。
